balls.text: powered away over extra-cover. Captain Hardik finishes GT's innings with a six. Jordan misses the wide yorker once again. Hardik gets underneath the length and carts it off the off side
edged between short third and the keeper. Very full and outside off, Hardik throws his bat at ball and slices it away for four more
slower ball from Jordan. He hides it away from the batter who swishes and misses. Off-side wide. Vinod collects the ball and throws the stumps down but by that time, Hardik stretches his bat in
full and outside off, not the perfect yorker but an acceptable delivery. Hardik sits back and pounds it down to long-off
very full and outside off, Rashid goes his trademark snake shot but does not get the desired elevation. Hits it to deep midwicket
first-ball four from Rashid. Pitched up and outside off, 144ks, Rashid gets underneath the length and slams it down the ground to the right of long-off
just short of a yorker length and outside off, Hardik hangs back and drills it down to long-off
full-toss outside off, Madhwal chases Sai who was backing away. Sai misses the scoop and wears it on his pads
yorker on the stumps, squirted away to square leg. Sai can't get it away
wide yorker outside off, Hardik stays back and squeezes it down the ground to long-off
skiddy bouncer outside off, beats Hardik on the hook
another full-toss outside off, sliced away in the air between wide long-off and deep cover as the bottom hand flies off the bat
Madhwal misses the yorker. Comes out as full-toss wide of off. High full-toss? Nope, dips below the waist. Hardik reaches out and carts it over the covers for six
Sai rolls out the scoop once again and manages to get it over short fine leg. On a length and on the stumps, Sai manufactures a four and punches gloves with his captain
full and wide of off, Hardik leans back and chops it away to deep third
shorter and kicks up outside off, Sai tries to over-hit it and drags an inside edge past leg stump. 200 up for GT
slower ball from Benrendorff, Sai shuffles across off and misses the scoop
Hardik carves a wide yorker towards deep third
slower one full and the left-armer takes it away from the reach of Hardik who swings and misses. He almost swings himself off his feet
wide yorker, Hardik camps back and scythes it away to Rohit at extra-cover

beamer outside off, Hardik ducks, looks away but sticks his bat up in the air. The ball goes behind square on the leg side and into the fine-leg fence. Madhwal puts his hand up in apology straightaway

Madhwal has Gill holing out. End of a sensational innings from Gill. Madhwal goes for another yorker. Speared on off stump, just short of a yorker length, shovelled in the air. He can't clear the outfielder. No mistake from David this time. Gill walks off to a standing ovation. The incoming Hardik wraps Gill up in a hug
Holes out off the free-hit. Mighty full and outside off, not quite a yorker. Sai lifts it straight to long-on
middle-stump yorker, tails into the stumps, Gill hangs back and clips away through midwicket. Madhwal has overstepped
Madhwal misses the yorker. It comes out as a low full-toss. Gill holds his shape and carts it over extra-cover
full and wide of off, just short of a yorker length, dragged away to midwicket off the inner half
off-stump yorker, stabbed down to long-off
Sai is turning up the tempo. He backs away manufactures swinging room, and slashes this off the stumps through point and right of sweeper cover for four more
dug in short and angling into the body of Sai who rocks back and hooks it over midwicket. Sai needs to turn up the tempo even further
on a heavy length and Jordan takes it away from the swinging arc of Gill. Wide of off, chopped into the covers
lashed away to the right of sweeper cover as Sai tosses the strike over to Gill
full and wide of off, Gill reaches out for the ball and scythes it away to sweeper cover
attempts a slower cutter but goes too wide. Off-side wide from Jordan

Jordan goes for the wide yorker. He just misses it, but it's still a hard-to-hit full-toss. But try telling that to Gill. He deliberately opens the bat face and carves it away to the left of sweeper cover. Jordan can't believe it. Rohit shakes his head
short and wide of off, off-side wide from Jordan
Gill looks to shimmy out of the crease once again, Green bangs it shorter and draws an inside edge to short fine leg

Oh wow, what a shot from Gill. Gimme a moment to pick my jaw up from the floor. Short-armed away for six more. He is putting on a six-hitting exhibition in Ahmedabad. He steps out, gets cramped but still manages to swat it away over the long-on fence
hip-high short ball outside off, another slower ball into the deck. Gill delays the pull and ends up swatting it between deep square and deep midwicket
slower ball, fullish and outside off, Gill gets hold of it and launches it straight over Green's head. He hits it straight of long-on for six more
short and skidding in to strike Sai on the thigh pad as he misses the pull

tapped down the ground to long-on. Gill notches up a 49-ball century - his third this season. Captain Hardik is up on his feet and applauds his opening batter along with the Ahmedabad crowd. Another Gill special in Ahmedabad
wide on the crease, skidding into the pads, as Jordan beats the leg-side flick, but this is certainly heading past leg stump
rapid bouncer outside off, Sai evades it
wide on the crease, full and on leg stump at 140.3ks, Sai closes the bat-face early and leading-edges it back in front of Jordan
Sai knows that mid-off is inside the circle and hits it over that infielder. Pitched-up delivery outside off, Sai gets underneath the length and lofts this slower ball over mid-off
hard-length delivery wide of off. Jordan hides it away from Gill. He reaches out and flashes a single to deep cover. Gill moves to 99
slower one outside off, Sai makes some room and guides a single just wide of short third
swished over the covers for a single
on the pads, Gill responds with a hard, flat sweep to deep square leg

here comes Gill again: down the track and smoked over wide long-on for a monster blow. He gets close to the pitch and unleashes another almighty swing for a 106-metre six. Ahmedabad loves it. Gill races through the nineties
shovelled away to the right of long leg for four more. Chawla slides an attempted googly down the leg side, Gill goes low and puts this away too
pushed through flatter and quicker on middle, worked away through midwicket. Gill sprints back for the second
Gill gives Chawla the charge. Wide on the crease, Gill manufactures his own length by racing out of the crease. Lofted nice and clean over the bowler's head
mighty full and outside off. Just short of a yorker length, driven down to long-off
another majestic six from Gill. A bit too full and angling into off stump, Gill picks it up and a strong whirl of the wrists sends the ball over midwicket
short and wide outside off, Sai gets on top of the bounce and slashes it away to deep cover
wide on the crease, full and sharply angling into the pads, whipped away along the ground to deep midwicket
Clobbered over midwicket. Madhwal ventures wide on the crease and darts a short ball outside off. Gill picks this up as well and dumps it over the leg-side boundary for six more
picked up and lifted over square leg for six. Too full and on the pads, Gill picks it up and launches it over the leg side in grand style
shorter and on top of off, another slower ball into the deck, chopped away to point
Green drops a difficult return catch. It does not stick. Pitched-up delivery outside off, thrashed back to Green who stretches out his hands in his followthrough, but the ball bursts out out
back-of-a-length cutter on off, no room for Gill to free his arms, chopped away weakly towards cover
slower ball, floated in at off stump, Sai opens the face and steals a single in front of point
drilled through extra-cover. Not a wide half-volley, but Sai lays into it and cracks it away through the covers. Hardik, who is padded up at the dug-out, was super impressed
back of a length and angling into a leg-side flick to David at deep midwicket
nudges a length ball on his pads through midwicket
launches it over square leg! It's length. Gill picks length really early. Gets down on one knee and sweeps it out of existence. His willingness to six-hit this season has been a bit of revelation
follows him as he makes room outside leg and yorks him as he tries to sweep. They sneak a leg bye to short fine
fifty up and Ahmedabad roars in approval. Simple little dink through midwicket. Another Gill special in Ahmedabad?
tucks the good length ball on middle and leg behind square leg. He's fuller to the left-hander
gets on the back foot and knocks the flatter ball on middle through midwicket
dangled up outside off and breaks away, Gill reaches out and flashes a drive to sweeper cover
wrong'un, breaking into middle and leg, clipped away through midwicket for a double
overpitched and outside off, Gill hangs back to this full ball, uses his hands and laces it to deep cover. Used the feet well last ball. Uses the hands well this ball. What a player
Shot, Gill! Pumped into the sightscreen. Tossed up full and outside off, he dashes out of the crease and launches Chawla straight over his head
on a length and turns into leg stump, nudged away through midwicket
Shot, Sai! Shovelled away between deep midwicket and wide long-on. Pushed through on the stumps, turns back in, whipped away firmly
on a good length and breaks back in at 97ks, clipped away through square leg by Sai
short-armed away in the air but does not carry to deep midwicket. Dragged away in the air. Taken on the bounce
Gill uses his feet, speared at 97ks, inside-edged onto the pad. The ball rolls back to Kishan. Gill returns to the safety of the crease by the time the keeper takes the bails off
full and on the stumps, 97ks, turned away through the leg side for one more
hip-high short ball on leg stump, Gill keeps back and hauls a pull away to deep square leg
shorter and skidding into the top of of stump, Sai hangs back and whips it away through midwicket
full and keeps a bit low on leg stump. Sai stays in the crease and works it behind square on the leg side
forced away to sweeper cover for a single
looped up and outside off once again, Sai meets the pitch of the ball once again, this time he drives it down to wide long-off
darted outside off, Sai stretches out and drives it to deep cover

Chawla strikes in his first over. Saha has run past this. Kishan gathers the ball and breaks the bails despite being blinded by the batter. Chawla hikes his pace and gets it to slide down the leg side. Saha is stumped off a leg-side wide
breaking into the pads once again, googly? Knocked away through midwicket once again
full and sliding into the pads, nudges it through midwicket and hares across for the second
on a length and nips back in at off, no room for Saha to free his arms, stabbed to cover

Jordan produces a chance, but David drops it at mid-on. David dives across to his right and goes with both hands but spills it. Difficult chance. Fullish and on the stumps, Gill checks his drive and chips it in the air. He gets away. 50 up for GT in the powerplay
back of a length and outside off, Gill throws his bat at ball and loses his shape. The inside edge evades the stumps. Kishan has it covered behind the stumps
crunnnnnnnnnched away through the covers. Back of a length and outside off, flat-batted away through the line
imperiously short-armed away over square leg for six. 111.2ks slower ball, half-tracker, Gill picks it up and launches it over the shorter leg-side boundary. Bam!
Re-set the radar, CJ. Back of a length and flung down the leg side
on a heavy length and just a shade outside off, Gill responds with a jabbing punch down to mid-off
swatted away to the right of deep square. Shortish and on the body from left-arm over to Saha who swivels on the back foot and finds the gap on the leg side
Gill gives the left-arm quick the charge, on-pace delivery on the stumps, which is clipped away through the vacant spaces at midwicket
slower ball into the pitch, tucks up Saha by darting it on leg stump. The knuckle ball is dabbed into the covers for a single
short-armed away to deep midwicket. Similar length and angling into middle, Gill uses the angle to his advantage and picks off a single
back of a length and on the stumps, too straight in line, Gill glances it away fine of short fine for four more
shortish and outside off, chopped away hastily into the covers
Thrashed over extra-cover. Short and wide outside off, Saha gives Madhwal the charge and pumps him over the off-side infield. What a response from Saha

Skiddy short ball from Madhwal. He pings Saha on the helmet. He is late onto the hook, looks away, and cops it on his head. The physio/team doctor is out to tend to Saha, which results in a hold-up in play
wide on the crease, full and holds its line outside off, 141ks. Gill opens the bat-face and eases it away to the left of sweeper cover
wide on the crease, hard-length delivery on off stump. Gill punches to short cover with a high elbow
back of a length and skidding through outside off from a low release point. This is Madhwal's USP. Gill aims to short-arm it away into the leg side but misses

wide on the crease, pitched-up delivery outside off, Gill stands tall and laces it through the line. Just two from Gill and Saha. Kartikeya, I think, slides to his right from sweeper cover and cuts it off in the deep
on-pace short ball, rises outside off, Saha opens the bat-face and dabs it with soft hands to short third
suspect this was the slower one from Behrendorff. 115.7ks variation outside off, tip and run to cover
shortish and on the hips, Saha hops and works it away to the right of short midwicket
chipped over mid-on as Saha gets into the act. Behrendorff goes too full and this does not swing either. Finishes on the pads, Saha puts it away
down the track and pumped over extra-cover. Intent from Gill: he uses his feet, does not get close enough to the pitch of this delivery but manages to get it over the infield
inswinger from Behrendorff. Veers back in against the angle. Gill ekes out an inside edge onto the pad
Gill rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and taps a single to deep third
a bit too full on the pads, Gill rolls his wrists and whips it away firmly through square leg for four more
Green pounds it on a heavy length and gets it to duck back in to cramp Saha. He dinks it just wide of slip
142ks, shortish and holds its line outside off. Gill stands up tall and punches it in the gap at cover. The ball plugs in the deep. Gill gets three more
shortish and veering into the hips, Saha can only glance it away as far as short fine leg
full and around off stump, Saha presses forward and push-drives to mid-off
straying into the pads once again, helped away to long leg for a single
pitched-up delivery on the pads, the ball does not come onto the bat. Saha checks his flick and chips it in front of short midwicket
short and into the body, Gill rolls his wrists and pulls it along the ground to deep square leg
nice and full, swings back in against the angle, Saha ekes out an inside edge onto the pad as the ball dribbles into the covers
some extra bounce for the Dorff. Back of a length and skipping away outside off, more with the angle. Saha has a jab at it and is beaten on the outside edge near the shoulder of the bat
good length and angling across off from left-arm over, left alone by Saha. The ball just about carries through to Kishan

Titans are in their second consecutive final, Miller seals it and Mohit's five-for with a boundary catch at long-on. He continues his joint-handed prayers. Delight in GT's dugout. It was a full ball that Kartikeya pumped straight. Decent hit but couldn't clear the fielder, took it around head-height.
Full on fourth stump, swept to long-on
Kartikeya clears the leg tries to slog it wide of mid-on. The fullish ball angles away and beats the bat
Little yells as Kartikeya french cuts it to the deep-fine boundary. The batter made room and tried to pull it off a length, went off the underegde
Full on leg, stays further down leg and works the 141kph ball to long-on
Length outside off, slapped to cover
Ducks under a bouncer going right over him
Backs away and drives the length ball along the ground through cover

Run-out chance, Sudharsan misses the direct hit at the non-striker's end from a few metres away. Fullish ball outside off was defended towards cover, went a couple of pitches away as the fielder ran in. Got the ball, took aim and missed it
Bouncer looked like it was slow but came at 130kph. Kartikeya swivelled on the pull and missed it
Two more stopped by Miller, this time to the left at long-on. It was a length ball that was pumped down the ground

Skier. Miller runs across from long-on, takes a sliding catch to give Mohit a four-for. Another back-of-hander. This tie on off, Chawla tried to mow it across the line, got a top edge. It was in the air for a while, Pandya, running from long-off, allowed Miller to go for it. Miller then charged to his diagonal right and did well to take it low.
In-betwee length just down leg, beats the flick and deflects off the pad towards square leg

Mohit's back-of-hand slower ball is driven straight to long-off, he has a three-for in seven balls. It was full, Jordan was too early into the shot and ended up kinda chipping it without conviction. Easy take for Sudharsan.
Length down leg, flicked to long leg
Length outside off, cut to backward point
Fullish ball is down leg
Fullish ball is down leg, Kartikeya tries to nudge it. Goes off the pad to short fine. LBW appeal is turned down

Rashid's celebrappeal for lbw is upheld, David reviews immediately. David went back deep in his crease, his back leg was outside off and front leg way down leg. He crouched as he tried to pull it. The ball was on the shorter side and was the topspinner. Is there an underedge? No, this looks dead. Yup, three reds it is. David goes.
Full on leg, flicked to deep square leg. Pace: 94.5kph
Whips the full ball along the ground to long-on
Shortish ball on fourth stump rises to top-of-stump height only. Blocked to cover

Spooned straight to cover, Mohit has a two-for in his first over. Length ball just outside off sticks in the pitch a bit, Vinod is early on the punch, can't check his shot. Soft dismissal is completed with Pandya taking a dolly.
Full outside off, punches it to long-off

Leg stump is on the ground, is that the game? Mohit joins his hand in prayer, SKY grins, closes his eyes and has head facing the heavens for a while. It was a fullish ball, SKY went across, his back leg was braced as he tried to paddle it fine. Missed it completely.
Surya's finding his timing now, nails this pull ten rows into the crowd over the midwicket boundary. It was a short ball just under waist-height, SKY pummeled it and hopped after
Back of length outside off, back-foot drive to cover
Back of length on off at 140kph, blocked with an angled bat towards cover for a single
Back of length over the stumps, defended in front
That's a fine scoopasaurus. Went across to get inside the line of the length ball and launched it fine. It went far and gets to fifty
Makes room and slaps it off a length through cover
Goes back in the crease and pulls it off a length. Lands a few metres behind the ropes and into the hands of a spectator

Shami backtracks and gets under the top edge off the pull, the ball has gone right through his fingers Funnily, Shami looked stoic, almost looking like he took it. It was a shortish ball that went right up. Shami was jogging back, got there easily and offered a live
Slower one into the pitch, beaten on the pull but is down leg
Length outside off, the googly spins away and beats the cut

Appeal for stumping sent upstairs. Didn't look like SKY's feet came out the crease. Fair ball. It landed on a length, around off stump, and angled away. SKY made room and tried to go for the big cover drive. Beaten, no contact with bat. The boot slid out of the crease but lodged back with a push of the heel. He's in as the bails are whipped off.
Wide and full, swipes the bat in a circular motion. Ball goes to long-off
Fullish ball at the stumps. It's pace is 95kph and is worked back to the bowler
WIde on a length, SKY reaches out and tries to slap it square on the off side. Thick outside edge flies away through the vacant slip area to short fine leg
Overpitched, SKY clears his front leg and heli-whips it flat and fast. Between long-on and deep midwicket for four

Miller saves four with a dive to the left at cover. Both batters were off for a run, ran back after seeing Miller, who threw the ball in one motion towards the striker's end. The ball was overpitched around fourth stump
Pitched up, sweet sounding off drive takes it past mid-off. Long-on runs across and saves two
Helps the shortish ball with a wristy pull to deep-backward square
Full ball is driven to deep cover

Bails fly. Little runs with his wings spread, then has finger on lips. Green walks back disappointed. It was on a back of length and didn't rise as much as Green expected, he tried to pull it away. He was also standing just outside leg and was cramped for room, it went just to the right of his bent back leg. His upper body bent late and by then, the ball flicked the bails like a carrom striker.
SKY tries to create the fusion between a flick and a pull, gets it off the sticker. The shortish ball goes behind square
Fullish ball on leg at 95kph, worked to long-on
SKY misses out on the free hit, tries to pull the length ball over square leg. Doesn't rise as much, goes off the underedge to short fine leg
Length outside off, guided to point off the back foot. Siren goes off, Noor's overstepped, he's over the crease. Fifty partnership up
Goes on one knee, flogs it off the fullish length over wide long-on. Green nonchalantly got up and scraped the crease with his spikes.
Width offered, Green tries to belt it wide of long-off. Beats him. Green's gloves are slippery and he asks for a new pair, umpire doesn't allow it
Whips it off the shin trough wide long-on.

Not a dissimilar ball, reaches out and cuts. Goes off the outside edge to short third. Batters are ball-watching and decelerated as they noticed they were heading into each other. Did collide but the momentum was off
Too wide outside off, left alone
Length ball is pushed to cover

Outside edge off the cover drive goes past short third's dive to the right. Backward point can't stop it. Green stepped leg side and tried to punch it off the back foot. Luckily, the edge took the ball in the gap
Sweeps the full ball from outside off to long leg. "How is he managing to sweep rashid regularly?" wonders Sid Monga
Brilliant placement, SKY flicks the length ball on leg through the gap between long-on and deep midwicket. All along the ground
Dances down and he launches it inside out over cover. It was a length ball that he got from the fuller side, thumped it for a one-bounce four
Sweeps the length ball at 99kph into the ground, rolls to deep midwicket's left. Stopped in the deep
Flicks the length ball at the stumps at 99kph to deep midwicket
Tries to take the slog sweep straight. Got on one knee but miscued the length ball that was given air, gets it to long-on
Fullish ball just outside off is pushed to cover, while staying down leg

Overpitched, slog sweep sails over deep square leg. It was down leg, perfect for Green to get on one knee and smacks it 88 metres far. Noor yells in frustration. Green gives a thumbs up to his partner.
Length just outside off, cut to the right of deep cover for an easy two
Length outside off at 92kph, slapped to deep point
Mistimes a cover drive that he tries to muscle too hard. It was overpitched and offered some room, ended up scraping it off the pitch. Ball fizzled and spun to the left of deep point
Length at the stumps, blocked in front
Chops the length ball outside off to deep point
Green is standing with all stumps visible to the bowler. Rashid's length ball follows him, beats the full-faced defence and hits the pad
Flicks it off a length, on the pads, to deep-backward square
Inside out over cover. Rashid bowls too full, it's on off and SKY makes room and lifts it
Length just outside off, chops into the ground off the underedge to cover point
Almighty swipe aimed over long-on is beaten by the full ball going away with the angle through fifth stump
Takes a big stride forward and sweeps it to deep square leg
Stands just outside leg and punches it off a length to deep cover
Back of length on off, cut through deep point, fielder runs to the left and keeps it to two
Length ball on fourth stump, worked to deep midwicket

Slog sweep beaten, middle and off stump rattled. Tilak's short, spicy stay at the crease ends. It was on a legbreak on a fullish length that came in, Tilak was on one knee and tried to muscle it again. With Rashid's stump-to-stump bowling, there was no getting away with missing. He curses his lungs out on his way back.
Length on off, nudged against the turn to midwicket. Fifty stand up. Pace: 94kph
Full ball is driven to mid-off
Tilak pulls and moves into the 40s off his 12th ball. It was a slightly short, he crouched a bit and bashed it past the diving deep-midwicket fielder
Back-foot punch with a straightish bat takes the length ball to long-on
Length ball beats the flick, hits the pad and falls in front

Lumped over midwicket, Shami's third over goes for 24! It was banged in, rose around rib-height and was angling away to fourth stump. Sat up perfectly for the pull that went far and stayed in the air for a while.
Ball goes deep into the outfield but Sudharsan is able to chase it down. Length ball was slow and on the pads, flicked gently through fine leg
The fourth four in a row is off a half-volley outside off, creamed along the ground through cover

Slower ball is whacked through wide mid-on, brings up MI's fifty. It was slot on middle, Tilak made a bit of room and tried powering it. Went off the thick inside edge and through the gap. Three fours in a row
Length on top of middle and off, pulled across the line. Hit flat into the grass, sizzles to the boundary
Dabs it fine, races between short third and backward point
Flicked over the infield, midwicket's long chase ends in vain. It was a length ball but on the pads, easy for SKY to pick it up
Dug in short. Just down leg around rib height, Tilak moves across and glances it off the back foot to deep fine leg.
Pulled ten rows back over the fine-leg boundary. He bent his knees as the back-of-length ball came in around waist-height, swivelled and launched it. Front leg came up in follow-through
Full on off, driven wide of mid-off
Tucks the length ball to midwicket
Length at the stumps, pushed to mid-on
Tilak made room and a bouncer went next to his nose. All he could do was sway away

Sweet sound off the flick, goes miles too. It was a full ball at the stumps, not overpitched by any margin, Tilak standing in front of leg allowed him to whip it across the line with full force in the bat swing. 92-metre six over square leg
Around that back of length again, angles in. Clipped to midwicket

Direct hit from Rashid at the non-striker's end, sent upstairs. Looks safe, Tilak has slid the bat in. It was a length ball that was nudged to the right of midwicket, Rashid ran towards the ball to his diagonal right, took it and threw it in one motion

Top edge off the flick goes right up... Little settles underneath and takes it. Back-of-length angling into the body, Rohit tried to help it along behind square, he was cramped for room and maybe beaten for pace too. Little did well to keep his eyes on the ball
Blocks the length ball back to the bowler
No sighters for him, doesn't need them when he gets a half-volley first ball. At the stumps and he used the high pace, 141kph, to whip it through wide mid-on

Ouch. Green makes room and is followed, gets hit just below the elbow. It was a shortish ball that was zipping in, Green tried to set up for a cross-batted shot but pulled his forearm close to his torso, the bat was in his hand as he jumped and the ball hit him flush on the skin. Pace: 146kph
Makes room and chops the back-of-length from the stumps into the grass. Goes high and on the bounce to point, who catches it
Green's bottom hand comes off as he pulls, the short ball is down leg beats him and goes with the angle to the keeper.

Green goes in for the quick single, Rohit was slow to take off but the throw is at the striker's end. No direct hit, he'd have been in though. Fullish ball in the channel was defended to backward point.
Similar-length ball this time on leg stump, flicked through square leg
Drifts down leg, Rohit helps the length ball along with a leg glance for a four through deep fine leg
Length ball is slightly wide, Green has to bend his upper body a bit as he slaps it along the ground through cover point

Wadhera is caught behind trying to pull. Hard-length ball outside off, Wadhera stood leg side and tried to whack it square. Didn't move his feet, the ball hopped off the edge and ballooned to the keeper.
Lifted over Noor, the jumping fielder at forward point. It was around a back of length outside off, Wadhera square punched it off the back foot
Length ball outside off is left one

Quick single to mid-on, Mohit charges and tries to pick it up with both hands, ends up splashing it off his wrists and the ball fizzles in front. So Rohit's safe. It was a length ball that was patted back.
On top of a length lands around off stump and curves away. Rohit shaped to play at it before letting it go
